event_chain.summary: Document with codes and passwords accidentally released

summary: Wiltshire Police in England accidentally released a document containing 13 door/entry codes and 13 passwords for police systems and buildings, including door codes to safe houses for rape and sexual assault victims, codes for digital evidence systems and a police computer password, plus contact details of 32 police contacts and details of prison officers at HMP Erlestoke, Winchester and Isle of Wight. The force opened an investigation; the leak was reported by The Telegraph on Nov 8 2025.
